title: ui: Convert the top-level ui files to C99 types

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • c0403442 - ui: Convert the top-level ui files to C99 types
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15039/diffs?diff_id=968303403&start_sha=58c77fa44b760f212dc64fb8cafc64f271369cd0)

added 7 commits
  • c0403442...574ed488 - 6 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 444cb3ce - ui: Convert the top-level ui files to C99 types
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15039/diffs?diff_id=968426686&start_sha=c0403442af77ee629e455607711c867a28fbea41)
If the `showRequested` signal is changed, then the various `connect` functions that refer to the signal need to be changed as well: !15060
Thanks. It looks like the only other old-style connection that uses a gboolean is openCaptureFile, but it looks like the default value is used in that case.
